critical_combat.configuration.title: Critical Combat Configuration
config.critical_combat.procedural_weapon: Whether items should be procedurally given weapon types. Set to false to only assign weapon types manually through datapacks.
All weapons at or below this attack speed are procedurally assigned to be two-handed. Set to 0 if you'd prefer for only manually tagged items to be two-handed. Set to 4 if you want all items to be two-handed.
The average amount the player's camera has to move per tick, in degrees, for a BLADE-type weapon (swords) to critically hit.
config.critical_combat.light_remove_atta: Whether LIGHT-type weapons (knives, etc.) should have their attack cooldown removed, using a combat system closer to pre-1.9 Minecraft.
config.critical_combat.heat_per_hit.tool: The amount of heat (% of total damage dealt with LIGHT-type weapons) that is gained with each successful hit from a LIGHT-type weapon. Set to 0 to disable the heat system.
config.critical_combat.heat_drain.toolti: The amount of heat (% of total damage dealt with LIGHT-type weapons) that is lost passively each second.
config.critical_combat.heat_damage_scale: The minimum % of damage dealt with a hit from a LIGHT-type weapon depending on your heat level. At 0.5, light weapons will do 50% damage at 0% heat, scaling up to 100% damage at 100% heat.
config.critical_combat.heat_resets_on_hu: Should heat (% of total damage dealt with LIGHT-type weapons) reset when you take damage.
config.critical_combat.combat_wear_coold: The number of seconds after attacking for which durability loss from attacks should be disabled. Helps keep LIGHT-type weapons from melting apart.
config.critical_combat.can_attack_on_coo: Whether you can attack during your attack cooldown. In vanilla, this is true.
config.critical_combat.swing_sounds.tool: Whether sounds should play when swinging weapons.
config.critical_combat.swing_particles.t: Whether swinging weapons should spawn particles.
config.critical_combat.blade_block_enabl: Whether BLADE-type weapons (swords, etc.) can block attacks by holding right-click.
Whether blocking with BLADE-type weapons should be breakable by any hit. Setting this to false makes breaking block require an axe or a heavy weapon.
config.critical_combat.blade_block_timer: How many seconds you can hold block with a BLADE-type weapon before your block window closes.
config.critical_combat.shield_block_time: How many seconds you can hold block with a shield before your block window closes. Set to 0 for no limit, like vanilla.
config.critical_combat.block_regen_timer: How many seconds it takes for your block timer to fully refill after you stop blocking.
config.critical_combat.axes_disable_bloc: Whether axes should be able to break past shields/blades. If set to false, only HEAVY-type weapons can break past shields/blades.
